title: Bilibili Toy deploy configuration
description: Configuration for one static Toy. Credentials belong in GitHub Actions Secrets.

slug.description: Immutable Toy URL component. An existing Toy with this slug under the authenticated account is adopted automatically.

directory.description: Static build output relative to the project containing toy.config.json; it must contain index.html at its root.

toy_id.description: Optional explicit existing Toy ID. It is checked against the current account and slug.

create.description: Applied only when creating a Toy. visibility defaults to link-only.

metadata.description: Applied only by a separate manual sync-metadata operation. Omitted fields retain their platform values.

relativePath.description: Repository-relative path without parent traversal, absolute prefix, or backslash. Symlinks are rejected by the Action.
